faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the WCD Odisha Rural Anganwadi Worker recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the WCD Odisha Rural Anganwadi Worker positions is 25th September 2026. It is advisable to apply well in advance of this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for the Rural Anganwadi Worker post?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement for the Rural Anganwadi Worker post is 18 years, and the maximum age limit is 42 years. Specific age relaxations may apply as per government rules.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Matriculation or an equivalent examination from a recognized board to be eligible for the Rural Anganwadi Worker position.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Rural Anganwadi Worker post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the post of Rural Anganwadi Worker announced under this recruitment drive by the Women and Child Development Department Odisha.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for the WCD Odisha Rural Anganwadi Worker jobs?
faq.answer: The application process for the WCD Odisha Rural Anganwadi Worker recruitment is entirely online. Candidates need to visit the official website to fill out and submit their application forms.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for the Rural Anganwadi Worker position?
faq.answer: The position of Rural Anganwadi Worker is offered on a contractual basis. This means the appointment will be for a fixed term as per the department's policy.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article. It contains all the detailed information regarding the recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website of WCD Odisha for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official website for this recruitment is http://engagement.awc.odisha.gov.in. Candidates can visit this site for application and further updates.

faq.answer: The key steps include filling the online form, uploading necessary documents, and reviewing all details before final submission. Ensure all information is accurate to avoid rejection.
